value.name: Oscar arrives at production office
value.description: Oscar enters the production office carrying a canvas backpack and settles into the room with Diana.
evidence: Diana is at the desk. OSCAR enters carrying a CANVAS BACKPACK, which he drops over the back of a chair.

value.name: Diana moves opening night
value.description: Diana informs Oscar that opening night has been rescheduled to Saturday because new funding required another rehearsal day.
evidence:
DIANA
I moved opening night. It is Saturday now. The new funding required one additional rehearsal day.

value.name: Oscar prepares with script
value.description: Oscar sits down and takes the script out of his backpack, signaling readiness to discuss or work.
evidence: Oscar sits and pulls the script from his canvas backpack.

value.name: Diana confirms new opening time by phone
value.description: After her smartphone buzzes, Diana answers and confirms that opening night is Saturday at eight o'clock.
evidence: Diana's SMARTPHONE buzzes on the desk. She picks it up and scrolls.

DIANA (CONT'D)
(into phone)
Yes, confirmed Saturday. Eight o'clock.

value.name: Diana takes coffee
value.description: Diana moves to the coffee machine, pours herself coffee, and drinks while the conversation continues.
evidence: She sets the phone down and crosses to the COFFEE MACHINE. She pours herself a cup and drinks.

value.name: Oscar reports Leon's unusual cheerfulness
value.description: Oscar tells Diana that Leon approached him that morning in an unexpectedly cheerful mood.
evidence:
OSCAR
Leon came to me this morning. He was cheerful.

value.name: Oscar says he signed Leon's cast
value.description: Oscar reveals that he signed Leon's cast and that Leon appeared to want the interaction.
evidence:
OSCAR
I signed his cast. He seemed to want it.

value.name: Oscar raises concern about Leon's right side
value.description: Oscar explains that Leon was guarding his right side all morning and specifically presented his right arm to be signed, implying a possible issue.
evidence:
OSCAR
He was protecting the right side all morning. More than the left.

OSCAR
I signed the right arm. He held it out specifically.

value.name: Diana dismisses Leon's behavior
value.description: Diana first questions the relevance of Oscar's report to opening night and then attributes Leon's behavior to compensation rather than responding with concern.
evidence:
DIANA
How is that relevant to opening night?
Diana pours a second cup of coffee and does not respond.
